# `pygeovision explain`

Grad-CAM saliency maps: which pixels most influenced a prediction. SHAP, uncertainty and attention maps are Python APIs
([Explainability](../../explainability/index.md)).

## When to use it

Use it to check whether a model looks at the right thing (the field, not the cloud edge).

## What you get

A heat-map image written to `--output`; `--class-idx` selects the class explained.

## Things to know

* Pass `--checkpoint`: the saliency of an untrained model is noise.
* A saliency map shows influence, not correctness. See [Grad-CAM](../../explainability/gradcam.md) for how to read it.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision explain [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Explainability — GradCAM saliency maps (SHAP, uncertainty and attention maps are Python APIs).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  gradcam  Generate GradCAM saliency map.
```

### `pygeovision explain gradcam`

```text
Usage: pygeovision explain gradcam [OPTIONS] IMAGE_PATH

  Generate GradCAM saliency map.

Options:
  -m, --model TEXT         [required]
  -o, --output TEXT
  -c, --class-idx INTEGER
  --checkpoint PATH        Your trained weights for --model (strict load). Saliency of an
                           untrained model is noise.
  --classes INTEGER        [default: 2]
  --in-channels INTEGER    Default: the image's band count.
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
```
